newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: GOLF-ALKER TAKES LEAD IN QUEENSLAND OPEN.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-ALKER TAKES LEAD IN QUEENSLAND OPEN.

text.p: Alker fired a 67 to take a one-shot lead over Australia's Greg
Chalmers after the third round of the Queensland Open on
Alker scored three successive birdies on the back nine to
lead the tournament with a 16-under par aggregate score of 203.
Chalmers, the overnight leader, lost his way to squander a
six-stroke advantage early in his round to finish with a level
Australians Andrew Bonhomme and Peter Lonard and New
Zealander Michael Long shared third place on 10 under after 54
